_doc: Key art slots of /proto/ - PLANNING ONLY (status 'planned'): no image exists and nothing is drawn in production.
A slot is an illustration window over the world (DOM, like the content cards), anchored to a stable layout object:
peak = anchor z + peak_offset; presence 1 within `core` metres of camera z from the peak, smooth to 0 at `range`.
Windows live only where the route is free: no content card visible, no camera focus, no transition dim
(tools/key_art.py checks it against content_points.json, camera_choreography.json and the layout presentation).
Sizes: display width in CSS px at a 1280x800 desktop; target_px is the art to commission (>= 2x display, DPR 2 + headroom).
Review only: /proto/?debug=keyart shows neutral placeholders; tests/browser/key_art_review.mjs renders the sheets.
Windows may touch the very tail of a camera focus only where its weight is <= 0.05 (the frame is ~40 m), and must end before the ground blend that leaves their own biome starts.
